Name: (CP) Buildable Tree Pack
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][size=5][color=#00ffff]This mod is a conversion and modification to the CP version of a mod that was previously released as a mod that works with SF.[/color] (Repealed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14654]SF version﻿﻿[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿)
[b][color=#ffff00]If an older version of the mod is installed, please delete that file. Overwriting with this mod will also cause an error, so be sure to delete the old file before installing this mod.[/color][/b][/size][/quote]

You need 4 hearts of friendship with Robin for trees to appear in her building menu.
(At this time, there will be no emails or event notifications.)

Palm trees and mushroom trees must meet additional requirements before they will appear in the build menu.
[spoiler]Once you have visited a set location, it will appear in Robin's construction menu.

Desert Palm Trees: Visit the Desert.
Island Palm Trees: Visit the Island South.
Mushroom trees: Visit the  Qi's Walnut Room.[/spoiler]

Normal trees are implemented as furniture in other mods, which are more convenient, but require "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿" to use, and using "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿" has the problem of long loading times, so I created this mod.


[size=3][b]The graphic trees in the other mods...[/b][/size]

"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿" (Created byAzrashar / Uploaded by[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/73472878]dugongkebalik[/url])
((Thanks for giving me permission to use ASSETS!))

"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]"(Created by[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url])
((Thanks for giving me permission to use ASSETS!))

"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]" (Created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91802318]grapeponta[/url])
(I contacted the creator to request permission to use the asset, but received no response. I will remove it if there are any problems.)


English and Japanese are supported.


If you want to place large trees on your farm, please use this mod.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22520][size=5](CP) Buildable Large Trees Pack[/size][/url]
